subtopic: Matching Investments to Goals and Time Horizon
source_evidence: The products that are right for you depend in part on your specific goals, investing timeframe, and risk tolerance.
answer: When considering an investment product, start by asking what goal it is meant to support and when you may need the money. Then compare the product’s features with your timeframe and risk tolerance. Also consider its potential risk and return, fees, and liquidity—how easily you can buy or sell it when you need money. No investment is risk-free, so matching a product to a goal means weighing these features rather than choosing by name alone.
